warnings: Hardware receipt reconciliation is separate from accuracy, domain and per-function acceptance.
Correlation measurements disagree in sign with ideal references; QRNG one-frequency is biased.
Histograms cannot reconstruct ordered random streams, secure keys or certified entropy.
Sampling-only intervals do not bound systematic hardware errors.
Frozen original financial input provenance remains; synthetic examples are not relabelled real market data.
All unverified or failed original cases retain their exact notebook and HTML bytes.
